additional_info.subject: ID0378656-DC/SI-D/IL[170000454] - DC outlets are not working CRM:00315001747
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel, good afternoon. How are you doing? Long time no see. I hope you are doing well.
Ziv raised a ticket for this charger HIGaDj where the DC outlets are not working due to the Error:
12VDC_Supply_TB18_FC23 this error is
true
: if LOGO cannot measure 12V at its digital input I6 in case of a power supply failure or tripped 12V fuse.
Please check the following:
12V in the output 1+ of the TB18
If FC23 is tripped → continuity check between 1 and 2
If it's not tripped then it's possible that feedback is not working properly
Check continuity between 13-14
If we have continuity, then please check in the cartridge if we are getting the 12V.
Check for any damage on KF10 pins
If we are getting 12V at the end of the cable reaching the KF10 and the error is not disappering then we should try and replace KF10.
As such, I recommend you to bring to site a spare TB18, FC23 and KF10.
What is your opinion?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0378656-DC/SI-D/IL[170000454] - DC outlets are not working CRM:00315001747
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel, good afternoon.
As you explained to me this morning:
The FC23 was tripped and after he rearmed it, everything was working properly.
We performed two tests.
First test charging using DC CCS in both connectors everything was fine the charging worked correctly.
In the second test he tried to charge using the AC, at the moment of the attempt FC23 tripped again.
We replaced the FC23 with a new one and then everything worked fine.
For me the problem is fixed and we can close the ticket.
Have you already communicated this to Ziv or should I write an email excluding all of these informations?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0378656-DC/SI-D/IL[170000454] - DC outlets are not working CRM:00315001747
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel, good afternoon.
This error's description is t
rue if:
a) at the last unlocking of the AC cable was not detected as successful
b) an unlocking of the charging cable was detected which was not controlled by the PLC. this can occur if the 12V supply to CA1 is interrupted
Have you tried rebooting? This might've happened because of the change we performed. Otherwise I will make a short troubleshooting guide on how to fix this.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
